The '''Sound amplification''' is a weave in the [[One Power]]; in its more simple form it is composed by only flows of element Air. It is used for example to amplify the voice of someone that is giving a speech to a crowd. With a touch of Fire it can be even more effective, but also very disturbing inside as when Egwene used it inside the Hall, to take the attention from the discussing Sitters.
